visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black cap, glasses, and a light green t-shirt walks outdoors in front of a stone monument with red characters and traditional votive tablets. He talks to the person behind the camera with an expressive face and wide eyes. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit tea shop. He holds a large cup of milk tea with visible black pearls, grass jelly, and pudding. Close-up shots detail the spoon lifting dark grass jelly and yellow pudding from the tea. (3) He takes a large sip, showing a satisfied facial expression, and then holds the cup out toward the viewer. (4) A sequence follows showing a passion fruit drink with black seeds and pearls. Close-ups show a gloved worker scooping toppings and shaking a drink. He drinks it enthusiastically while standing outside the shop. (5) He holds a third drink, a light-colored jasmine milk tea with translucent square 'powder corners' (toppings). Detailed shots show the jasmine tea being poured over the toppings and mixed with milk. (6) A montage appears showing three distinct drinks against a bright orange background. Finally, the exterior of a 'CoCo' storefront with orange signage is shown with a truck parked nearby.
